REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - NOVEMBER 13, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.gov in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. 11A.
Report from City Manager/Executive Director
During this part of the meeting the City Manager/Executive Director or designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior City Council meeting, including any request by the City Council to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior City Council meeting's agenda.
11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, verbal reports will also be provided in such cases where the City Council-appointed delegate and/or alternate is unable to attend a scheduled meeting, and there is insufficient time to schedule an agenda item for Council consideration of another alternate, necessitating a Mayor's urgency appointment. Requests may also be made of staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item, except to cancel or reschedule a City Council public meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
NOVEMBER 13, 2025, 7:00 PM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Rick Westra, Trinty Christian Reformed Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Michelle Lovell, Soroptimist International of
  Artesia-Cerritos.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jennifer Hong
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Sophia M. Tse
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Lynda P. Johnson
  Mayor/Chair Frank Aurelio Yokoyama

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  A proclamation was made by the City Council honoring:

  Bermingham Controls, Inc. (Business Spotlight).

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period for items not listed on the meeting
  agenda but that were within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council, the
  Consent Calendar, and Closed Session.

  Teddy Lloyd thanked the City Council for a successful Veterans Day Ceremony and
  spoke regarding revenue generation through expansion of the City’s pickleball court
  usage and a potential for reservation fee collection.

  Tobi Balma expressed concern regarding cellular service and Wi-Fi outages
  throughout the City and specifically in the neighborhood adjacent to Heritage Park.

  Kirit Chauhan congratulated the City on a successful Veterans Day Ceremony and
  expressed concern regarding the Cerritos Library one (1) day per week closure and
  suggested consideration of alternative cost-saving measures.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, November 13, 2025, 7:00 p.m.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  The Mayor announced that prior to the meeting, the Council/Agency members
  received full-text, unredacted copies of the one (1) written comment submitted for
  Item 6 (inclusive of one comment for Item 7C), by the deadline listed on the agenda
  and for inclusion in the official record. Requests for copies of the written comments
  submitted for this meeting can be made during regular business hours to the Office
  of the City Clerk.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Monday, October 27, 2025, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special
  Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Johnson, to approve the
  Thursday, October 27, 2025, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special
  Meeting Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of Financial Reports

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated November 13, 2025
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Johnson, to approve the Register

  City of Cerritos  November 13, 2025  $14,453,680.45 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama

  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Adoption of Ordinance:

  Ordinance introduced at the Monday, October 13, 2025, City Council/Successor
  Agency Special Meeting:

  Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1052, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  OF CERRITOS APPROVING DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2025-3, A REQUEST
  TO AMEND SECTION 22.40.730 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE, REMOVING
  THE QUANTITY LIMITATION ON SELF-STORAGE FACILITIES PERMITTED IN THE CITY
  OF CERRITOS (COUNCIL).

  *Pursuant to Sections 15378(b)(5) and 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA
  review.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Johnson, to:

  1. Waive full reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 1052, AN ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2025-
  3, A REQUEST TO AMEND SECTION 22.40.730 OF THE CERRITOS
  MUNICIPAL CODE, REMOVING THE QUANTITY LIMITATION ON SELF-
  STORAGE FACILITIES PERMITTED IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS (COUNCIL);
  and

  2. Direct the City Clerk to publish a notice of adopted ordinance within fifteen (15)
  days after adoption of Ordinance No. 1052, as required by California Government
  Code Section 36933 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Award of a professional services contract for water quality analyses and laboratory
  services (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Johnson, to:

  1. Authorize a professional services contract with Enthalpy Analytical, LLC for water
  quality analyses and laboratory services for $59,488 annually; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute the contract and any
  contract modifications, in accordance with the City's adopted Purchasing and
  Contracting Policy (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING A GUIDEBOOK FOR ELECTED
  AND APPOINTED OFFICIALS (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Cynthia Nava, City Clerk. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Tobi Balma expressed concern regarding amendments to public speaker time
  provisions stated on public meeting agendas, referenced in the “Order of Business”
  and “Public Comments and Suggestions” sections of the proposed City of Cerritos
  Guidebook for Elected and Appointed Officials. She also requested a definitive
  maximum public comment time provision on Cerritos public meeting agendas.

  Kirit Chauhan expressed opposition to a potential one (1) minute maximum public
  comment time provision and inquired regarding public meeting parliamentary
  procedures.

  Cynthia Nava, City Clerk, announced that prior to the meeting, the Council/Agency
  members received full-text, unredacted copies of the two (2) written comments
  submitted for Item 9A, by the deadline listed on the agenda and for inclusion in the
  official record. Requests for copies of the written comments submitted for this
  meeting can be made during regular business hours to the Office of the City Clerk.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Pulido, with acceptance of a
  friendly amendment by Yokoyama, to:

  1. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2025-33, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADOPTING A GUIDEBOOK
  FOR ELECTED AND APPOINTED OFFICIALS, inclusive of the following
  amendments to the proposed Guidebook for Elected and Appointed Officials
  (Guidebook) (deletions noted in strikethrough and additions noted in bold text)
  (COUNCIL):

  a. Chapter 1 – Introduction, Section E. Guidebook Administration – Biennial Review

  •  Upon receipt of City Council consensus direction, given at a public meeting,
  an Internal Ad Hoc or Administratively Appointed Working Group will review
  the Guidebook and provide recommendations to the City Council at a
  subsequent public meeting.

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, November 13, 2025, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 8

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  b. Chapter 3 – Meetings, Section A. Placing an Item on the Public Meeting Agenda

  City Council

  •  At a public meeting (preferred): Request consensus concurrence from at
  least one (1) other Councilmember; or

  •  Via email Written request: Consult with only one (1) other Councilmember
  and submit request via email in writing to the City Manager…

  Advisory Boards

  •  At a public meeting: Request consensus concurrence from at least one (1)
  other Advisory Board member…

  c. Chapter 3 – Meetings, Section C. Order of Business (City Council)

  •  Public Comments and Suggestions…Verbal comments may be limited to one
  three minutes per speaker, subject to the Mayor/Chair extending to a
  maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to
  exceed 45 minutes unless the Mayor/Chair extends.

  •  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports…Subject
  to City Council consensus, Requests may also be made of staff reports…

  d. Chapter 3 – Meetings, Section D. Order of Business (Advisory Boards)

  •  Public Comments and Suggestions…Verbal comments may be limited to one
  three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of
  five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes
  unless the Chair extends.

  e. Chapter 3 – Meetings, Section E. Voting on Agenda Items

  •  In the event electronic voting cannot be used, the Mayor/Chair may call for a
  roll call vote requesting for “ayes” first, then “nays,” then abstentions.

  f.  Chapter 6 – City Council Use of Facilities

  •  Each Councilmember is limited to a maximum of six (6) community center
  meetings per year, with a maximum of 90 minutes per meeting.

  •  Requests shall be submitted in writing to the City Manager for review and
  processing at least three (3) one (1) weeks prior to the proposed meeting
  date.

  ; and

  2.  Direct the Office of the City Clerk to post the City of Cerritos Guidebook for Elected
  and Appointed Officials to the City's website and disseminate the document to all
  City Elected and Appointed Officials after City Council consideration and potential
  approval of new Advisory Boards, at a future public meeting (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, November 13, 2025, 7:00 p.m.

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Pulido, to direct staff to prepare
  an agenda report, resolution, and ordinance for City Council consideration at a future
  publicly noticed meeting, to:

  1. Dissolve the Let Freedom Committee; and

  2. Establish the City Celebrations Committee (with consideration of current Let
  Freedom Ring Committee member appointment to this Committee), to assist in the
  planning of Citywide special events, including the Festival of Friendship, Halloween
  Festival, Let Freedom Ring (Independence Day) Celebration, Santa’s Sleigh Day,
  Spring Fling and Fireworks Spectacular, UbeFest, and Water Lantern Festival
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Pulido, to direct staff to prepare
  an agenda report, resolution, and ordinance for City Council consideration at a future
  publicly noticed meeting, to establish a Senior Services Commission that will serve as an
  advisory body to the Council researching and recommending policies, programs, and
  services related to senior, accessibility, and disability needs (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hong, Pulido, Tse, Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
